speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for National Development with regard to Project DIAN@M3 which helps Malay families in public rental flats to achieve home ownership, how will these efforts (i) complement existing efforts by HDB’s Home Ownership Support Team (HST) to avoid duplication and (ii) be resourced to achieve intended outcomes of integrating assets towards enhancing home ownership of the Malay/Muslim community.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Within the Malay/Muslim community, the M3 network has various programmes that complement the Government’s initiatives in supporting lower-income and vulnerable families.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Project DIAN@M³, which focuses on Malay/Muslim families, will focus on the following aspects.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: First, we want to improve inter-generational mobility by giving more attention to families with children staying in rental flats.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This includes helping these families utilise their SkillsFuture credits and linking them up with career counselling programmes under MENDAKI SENSE.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We also want to encourage more women to join and remain in the workforce.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Third, we will ensure that families have access to social support that can help them to grow a positive family environment.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is done through programmes such as Bersamamu and Project ARIF, which support newly wed couples for family life, maternal wellness and child development.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For example, ECO will equip volunteers reaching out to families staying in rental flats with the knowledge and skills to perform last-mile outreach.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We welcome more who wish to be part of Project DIAN@M³, and partner us on this important effort.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Ultimately, we hope the concerted support will enable the vulnerable families to achieve home ownership.
